title: Story opening: larger planet on the same kernel, terraced polar clearing, SH02 arrival lab
context: The owner wants a better initial story: the rocket lands on a larger planet, only Isao is there, the base grows slowly on 4 m foundations, and defenses emerge later. Planning questions settled: substrate, terrain approach, full base size, player role, and the SH02 landing with a borrowed plume effect. The owner asked for a localhost version before further design sections.
outcome: Decisions: a new larger sphere on the pinned grid kernel (16,000 points, 71,314 cells, radius 753 m at 10 m per cell, lane density matching the defense map) rather than a flat world or a separate flat stage; a medium planet with 2 m terraces rather than a kilometre-scale planet with wide lanes; a full base the size of the Astro yard (about 240 x 160 m, eight terrace levels) rather than karyoku's 400 x 304 m; the opening encounter as Isao prints a Rotor the player aims by hand, an armored gate closes the natural entry and weak enemies pile up outside. Built: content/core/domain modules for the recipe, terrace profile, clearing with one open lane mouth and the arrival timeline, all Node-tested; the SH02 pinned by checksum at upstream d39f3a78e; a labs.html#story tab rendering the lattice, tiled pad, rocket, ported MIT plume, dust, scorch and Isao at 2.5 m; a --story browser acceptance with screenshots. Planet generation takes about 4 s in the browser. Deferred: sound, chunked rendering, raymarch governor, kit retaining edges/ramps/piers, the encounter, construction and emergence. The fiction assumption (a new natural world; Stålheart is the machine) is recorded in the spec and awaits owner confirmation.
alternatives: Give up the sphere for flat terrain: rejected, retires the shell fiction, pole heart, antipode relay and sphere-arc distances.
Separate flat story stage: rejected, story and defense would run on two worlds.
Large 2.6-4.8 km planet with 35-64 m cells: rejected for now, lane width and enemy scale no longer match the defense game and lane mouths need walls to narrow them.
Karyoku-size base: rejected on the medium planet, it stacks 22 terrace levels and 43 m of drop.
